verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official CLI (salesforcecli/cli, installed via `npm install -g @salesforce/cli`). It covers data queries, scratch org creation, Apex tests and AI-relevant agent commands (`sf agent create`/`activate`), and it has a plugin developer guide. A community user independently corroborates it as a "passable command line tool" alongside other developer tooling. Missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable/JSON output and non-interactive auth for agent-driven automation, and stronger independent praise than "passable".
